hero.headline: MUJ Online MBA in Retail Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: UGC-DEB approved Super/Dual specialization. 12 spec subjects in Sem 3-4. NAAC A+, NIRF University #58.

sections.tldr: MUJ Online MBA in Retail Management covers retail marketing, store operations and management, category management in retail, consumer buying behaviour, retail supply chain management, e-retailing, visual merchandising, and mall management for professionals targeting store head, category director, or retail operations VP roles. Super/Dual spec, pair with Marketing or Supply Chain.

about.body:
Retail Management is the MBA specialization for professionals who run physical and digital retail operations: store managers, category managers, visual merchandisers, e-commerce operations executives, and mall management professionals who want to move into Regional Head, Category Director, or VP Retail Operations roles.

MUJ's Super/Dual specialization is a strong strategic move for retail professionals. Pairing Retail Management with Marketing creates a complete brand marketing and retail execution credential for omnichannel leadership roles. Pairing with Supply Chain Management builds an end-to-end retail and fulfilment credential for category director and supply chain head roles at large format retailers and e-commerce companies. Both combinations are sought by India's modern retail chains and D2C brands.

Manipal University Jaipur Online is NAAC A+ accredited with NIRF University #58 for 2025. EdifyEdu verifies accreditation data independently and does not receive commission from MUJ. Full programme overview at /universities/manipal-university-jaipur-online/mba.

subjects.name: Strategic Management
subjects.description: Retail strategy, market entry for new store formats, competitive positioning, and omnichannel retail business model design.

subjects.name: Term Paper
subjects.description: Independent research paper applying retail management theory to a real-world store, category, or e-commerce challenge.

subjects.name: Retail Marketing
subjects.description: Retail brand positioning, in-store and digital customer acquisition, loyalty programme design, and promotional planning.

subjects.name: Consumer Buying Behaviour
subjects.description: Purchase decision models, consumer psychology in retail environments, shopper research methods, and behaviour-driven merchandising.

subjects.name: Project
subjects.description: Major dissertation applying retail management specialization to an original applied store, category, or e-commerce study.

subjects.name: E-Retailing
subjects.description: E-commerce platform strategy, marketplace management, D2C channel building, digital shelf analytics, and online retail P&L.

subjects.name: Visual Merchandising
subjects.description: Store layout principles, window display design, planogram compliance, and the use of visual cues to drive conversion and basket size.

subjects.name: Mall Management
subjects.description: Mall leasing strategy, tenant mix management, footfall generation, revenue sharing models, and mall operations governance.

syllabus.note: Subjects as listed in the university syllabus we hold. Universities revise subjects between intakes.

whoHires.body:
**Industries:** Large format retail, E-commerce and D2C, FMCG modern trade, Mall developers and operators, Franchise retail networks

**Entry-level roles:** Store Manager, Category Executive, Visual Merchandising Executive, E-commerce Operations Analyst

**Mid-level roles:** Regional Store Manager, Category Head, Retail Operations Manager, E-commerce Category Manager, Mall Leasing Manager

**Senior roles:** VP Retail Operations, Category Director, Head of E-commerce, COO (retail company), Business Head (retail format)

**How to check placement claims:** ask Manipal University Jaipur (MUJ) Online for its latest placement report in writing, for your programme and mode. Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. Treat the roles above as the kinds of jobs this syllabus prepares you for, not as a list of who has hired from this batch.

skills.body:
The Retail Management specialization builds skills that modern retail, e-commerce, and mall management employers test at category manager and retail operations director levels:

- Category Management: assortment planning using distribution and penetration metrics, planogram development, space productivity analysis, and promotional ROI measurement
- Store Operations: store P&L construction, shrinkage and loss prevention frameworks, conversion rate improvement levers, and staff productivity KPIs
- E-Retailing: marketplace listing optimisation, digital shelf analytics, D2C conversion rate optimisation, and e-commerce fulfilment cost management
- Retail Supply Chain: replenishment system design, vendor-managed inventory contracts, distribution centre slotting, and retail inventory accuracy management

- Visual Merchandising: brand-consistent planogram compliance, seasonal window change management, and in-store navigation design for large format stores
- Mall Management: tenant NPS measurement, footfall analytics, anchor-specialty tenant mix design, and common area maintenance cost management

**Soft skills:** Presenting category performance and range review recommendations to vendor partners, managing multi-store teams across geographies, building the business case for store format investments, and communicating retail P&L to non-retail finance stakeholders.

comparisons.body: **vs NMIMS Online MBA:** NMIMS does not offer a dedicated Retail Management specialization in its online MBA. NMIMS Marketing Management covers retail as a distribution channel subject. For professionals specifically targeting retail operations, category management, or mall management careers, MUJ's dedicated 12-subject spec is far more targeted.

certificate.body: The Manipal University Jaipur degree certificate carries the Manipal University Jaipur name, the MBA designation, and identifies the online learning mode per UGC-DEB 2020 regulations. The Retail Management specialisation is noted on the marksheet and transcript. The certificate names the online mode, as UGC-DEB rules require. It counts the same as a regular MBA for jobs, promotions and further study.

faqs.question: Can I choose dual specialization with the MUJ Online MBA in Retail Management?
faqs.answer: Yes. Strong combinations: Retail Management plus Marketing (for omnichannel brand and marketing credential), Retail Management plus Supply Chain Management (for category-to-shelf retail operations), or Retail Management plus Digital Marketing (for e-commerce and D2C retail growth roles). Both specializations are recorded on your marksheet.

faqs.question: Is this MBA useful for franchise operators and retail entrepreneurs?
faqs.answer: Yes. The store operations, category management, and retail supply chain subjects are directly applicable to franchise and retail business owners. The store P&L management, shrinkage control, and vendor negotiation content gives structured frameworks for operational decisions that most franchise operators make intuitively. Pairing with Marketing or Supply Chain adds brand management and procurement credentials useful for expanding franchise networks.

chooseIf: You want to pair Retail Management with Marketing or Supply Chain for an omnichannel or end-to-end category credential using MUJ's Super/Dual spec.
consider: You are targeting senior retail leadership at premium lifestyle brands where MICA or NIFT's management programmes have stronger brand recognition for creative and fashion retail careers.
You need an internationally recognised retail credential for a global retail brand, IMRB or GCSR-accredited retail management programmes have specific international employer recognition.
